nodes.description: msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance and whitelist checks

uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount configured by init()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount configured by init()
uint256 private _saleNum; number of allowed sales per address configured by init()
uint constant public decimals = 18; used for scaling in init()
string public name; token name set in constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; hardcoded router address whitelisted in ensure() and pre-approved in constructor
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable - sets owner to msg.sender, mints supply, grants unlimited allowance to UNI router
transfer(address,uint) public payable - forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view - whitelist/anti-bot gate using owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and condition()
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable - main state-mutating transfer path with unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic
approve(address,uint) public payable - writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition(address,uint) internal view - enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits using _onSaleNum
delegate(address,bytes) public payable - owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public - owner-only configuration of sale limits with unscaled multiplication
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable - owner-only bulk send using unchecked multiplication and subtraction
setTradeAddress(address) public - owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure - computes Uniswap pair address via keccak256
